description: issue #684 (slice I5): the multiline `on_key ... end on_key` form requires its closing label to match the block-head; closing an `on_key` block with `end when` is rejected at PARSE stage with `ol-mismatched-end` (spec/interaction-events.md's event-end grammar; spec/error-model.md's `ol-mismatched-end`; the `END_LABELS` registration C2 (#664) added for `on_key`). Because the parse fails, `execute()` bails before running anything, so no events are emitted. The diagnostic's span covers the wrong label word and its params carry the expected (`on_key`) vs actual (`when`) labels, with a did-you-mean pointing back at `on_key`.
